title: Kth Largest Element In An Array
description:
Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the kth largest element in the array.
Note that it is the kth largest element in the sorted order, not the kth distinct element.
Can you solve it without sorting?
 
Example 1:
Input: nums = [3,2,1,5,6,4], k = 2
Output: 5
Example 2:
Input: nums = [3,2,3,1,2,4,5,5,6], k = 4
Output: 4

 
Constraints:

1 <= k <= nums.length <= 105
-104 <= nums[i] <= 104

def check(candidate):
    assert candidate([3, 2, 1, 5, 6, 4], 2) == 5
    assert candidate([3, 2, 3, 1, 2, 4, 5, 5, 6], 4) == 4
    assert candidate([1], 1) == 1
    assert candidate([-1, -2, -3], 2) == -2
    assert candidate([7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1], 5) == 3
    assert candidate([2, 1, 2, 1, 2], 3) == 2
    assert candidate([10000, -10000, 0], 2) == 0
    assert candidate([5, 5, 5, 5], 2) == 5
